name: fcf-warriors-fair-match
description: FCF Warriors' Iowa State Fair personality matching PWA. Cloudflare Pages + D1.

scripts.db:init: npx wrangler d1 execute fcf-warriors-db --remote --file schema.sql
scripts.db:reset: npx wrangler d1 execute fcf-warriors-db --remote --command "DELETE FROM messages; DELETE FROM matches; DELETE FROM profiles;"
scripts.set-key: npx wrangler pages secret put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
